name: Kenneth Joseph Schriefer
sources: Barbara McKeldin Adams, "Barbara McKeldin Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
Ancestry.com, U.S., Newspapers.com Obituary Index (Baltimore Sun and Evening Sun death notices)
notes: Son of George "Goode" and Ethel (Quinn) Schriefer; brother of Emily Schriefer McKeldin, shown with her and their mother in a family photo. [Barbara McKeldin Adams, A Memoir, text line 284]
Kenneth J., aged 7 in the 1930 census and 16 in 1940; named Kenneth Joseph in his parents' death notices.
